reason: I'd take the free visit to see it, but $15 a kid adds up fast on one paycheck and CoCo's is cheaper. I'm not paying that every week with two kids.
objection: Isn't this just CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor? $15 a visit per kid, plus a sibling, is a real chunk of my grocery money for a play room.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in price around $8-10 per kid, or the moms group $8 rate working on evenings and weekends around my shifts.
